headline: Ravens C Jovaughn Gwyn Fractures Fibula, Could Miss 2-3 Months
summary: The Ravens won a 34-31 thriller over the Cowboys in Week 3, but they did not escape Brazil unscathed. Starting center Jovaughn Gwyn fractured his fibula and is expected to miss two to three months, Jamison Hensley of ESPN reports. summary: Coaching inexperience is holding the Cowboys back.

headline: Buccaneers put WR McMillan on IR, add QB Rypien to practice squad
summary: The Buccaneers placed wide receiver Jalen McMillan on injured reserve Wednesday, sidelining him for at least the next four games.

headline: Can the 0-3 Texans defy history again to make playoffs?
summary: Houston became the first team in the common playoff format to make the postseason after starting 0-3 in 2025.
